purpose: Bundle-first wanted list for papers that are high-value review targets but do not currently have an obvious matching local PDF in the private library. This file intentionally tracks wanted assets before they become formal paper records in data/papers.json.

bundles.title: STDP, hidden spike patterns, and constructive synapse initialization
bundles.thesis_anchor: Chapters 3, 6, and 7 of /workspace/thesis-constructive-spiking; especially hidden spike-pattern detection and competitive STDP pattern learning.
bundles.rationale: The thesis cites Masquelier2008a and Masquelier2008b heavily, but no obvious Masquelier PDFs were found by filename in /workspace/growing-neural-networks-library. These are anchor sources for turning the thesis-derived STDP construction material into grounded public reviews.

wanted_assets.title: Spike timing dependent plasticity finds the start of repeating patterns in continuous spike trains
wanted_assets.expected_local_path: ../growing-neural-networks-library/pdfs/Masquelier T, Guyonneau R and Thorpe S J (2008) - Spike timing dependent plasticity finds the start of repeating patterns in continuous spike trains.pdf
wanted_assets.why_wanted: Most-cited thesis source in the local scan; it grounds the repeating hidden spike-pattern experiments that the site should eventually explain interactively.

wanted_assets.title: Competitive STDP-Based Spike Pattern Learning
wanted_assets.expected_local_path: ../growing-neural-networks-library/pdfs/Masquelier T, Guyonneau R and Thorpe S J (2009) - Competitive STDP-Based Spike Pattern Learning.pdf
wanted_assets.why_wanted: Primary anchor for the thesis' competitive spike-pattern chapter; needed before drafting a confident public synthesis of competitive STDP construction.

bundles.title: STDP background mechanisms for constructive spiking reviews
bundles.thesis_anchor: Chapter 2 literature review and the STDP-dependent experimental chapters of /workspace/thesis-constructive-spiking.
bundles.rationale: These papers are not necessarily constructive algorithms themselves, but they provide the STDP mechanism background needed to keep spiking construction reviews accurate and well-grounded.

wanted_assets.title: Competitive Hebbian learning through spike-timing-dependent synaptic plasticity
wanted_assets.expected_local_path: ../growing-neural-networks-library/pdfs/Song S, Miller K D and Abbott L F (2000) - Competitive Hebbian learning through spike-timing-dependent synaptic plasticity.pdf
wanted_assets.why_wanted: Canonical STDP/competitive Hebbian background source; useful for explaining what is inherited versus newly constructive in later spiking papers.

wanted_assets.title: What can a neuron learn with spike-timing-dependent plasticity?
wanted_assets.expected_local_path: ../growing-neural-networks-library/pdfs/Legenstein R, Naeger C and Maass W (2005) - What can a neuron learn with spike-timing-dependent plasticity.pdf
wanted_assets.why_wanted: Provides theoretical limits/capabilities of STDP learning that can frame constructive synapse and neuron-creation claims.

wanted_assets.title: Spike timing-dependent plasticity: A Hebbian learning rule
wanted_assets.expected_local_path: ../growing-neural-networks-library/pdfs/Caporale N and Dan Y (2008) - Spike timing-dependent plasticity; A Hebbian learning rule.pdf
wanted_assets.why_wanted: Review-style background for STDP; helpful for careful explanatory prose before deep dives into constructive spiking algorithms.

wanted_assets.title: Phenomenological models of synaptic plasticity based on spike timing
wanted_assets.expected_local_path: ../growing-neural-networks-library/pdfs/Morrison A, Diesmann M and Gerstner W (2008) - Phenomenological models of synaptic plasticity based on spike timing.pdf
wanted_assets.why_wanted: Supports accurate discussion of STDP modelling assumptions, especially where the thesis turns timing rules into construction mechanisms.

bundles.title: Classic constructive foundations
bundles.thesis_anchor: Chapter 2 constructive neural-network taxonomy and the public site's existing Cascade-Correlation/DNC foundation.
bundles.rationale: Most initial constructive/pruning PDFs are now present locally, but one existing seed review still has no obvious local asset by filename.

wanted_assets.title: Chaining Together Simple Modules to Create Complex Functions
wanted_assets.why_wanted: Existing public review draft has weak bibliographic grounding and no obvious local PDF; collect if a reliable CMU report scan or author bibliography copy is available.

notes: This file is deliberately narrower than data/paper-assets.json: it tracks prominent wanted assets for bundle planning, including papers not yet added to data/papers.json.

When a wanted PDF is collected, keep the PDF outside Git, update this file or remove the wanted entry, and only then decide whether to promote the paper into data/papers.json plus data/paper-assets.json.

The filename scan on 2026-06-28 found no obvious Masquelier, Morrison, Caporale, or Legenstein PDFs in /workspace/growing-neural-networks-library. Song-author filename hits were unrelated to Song2000.
